texte.Führe deine Station durch die Runden: Ba:
Lead your station through the rounds: build mushroom farms, ammo factories and customs posts, hire rangers and mercenaries and send them to the surface – from the Forest of Da'zar to the Demon Portal. The deeper you go, the better the loot.

Win by taking over all other stations, completing three Hansa contracts, or taking the Military Base and wiping out the Nest – or an opponent – with four nuke parts.

Play against the AI or over the Internet with up to seven friends.

texte.Gewinne auf einem von vier Wegen: (1) Üb: Win in one of four ways: (1) Take over all other player stations. (2) Complete 3 Hansa contracts. (3) Get intel from the Hansa – then the Military Base lies in the extreme deck of the Demon Portal –, take it, collect the four nuke parts propulsion, casing, warhead and detonator, and fire the nuke at an opponent. (4) Find the Nest in the extreme deck and destroy it – with the nuke or conventionally, if an attacking unit carries the Laser Marker.
Drawn cards are revealed below. Decide: fight, flee or play a card.

texte.Invasionskarten schicken Mutanten gegen: Invasion cards send mutants against all, one, or all but one other player. The defenders are the units in base and preparation, the two Station Guards and every DShK MG. If the defense falls, the mutants destroy a building. The Hermetic Gate keeps mutants out completely. Once the Nest is found, it attacks every station each round – and it gets stronger every second round. The invasion phase needs no confirmation: whoever has no invasion card, no “Sabotage Entrance Gate” and no nuke ready to fire is done automatically.
texte.Ist die Hanse-Station besetzt, befreie s: If the Hansa Station is occupied, free it with a station attack.
The tunnels shift every round. From the exit you only reach stations connected by tunnel to one of your stations. A squad in a surface zone can attack any station – the defenders see it coming (awareness −1).
texte.Jede Runde wird das Netz neu gelegt. Vom: The network is laid out anew every round. From the exit you only reach stations directly next to one of your stations on a line. A squad in a surface zone can attack any station – the defenders see it coming (awareness −1).
texte.Jeder Ausbau: +2 Gebäudeplätze, +2 Range: Each upgrade: +2 building slots, +2 ranger slots and more visible slots in defense, preparation and exit.
texte.Jeder Ranger hat 4 Ausrüstungsplätze (Sc: Every ranger has 4 equipment slots (Sniper 3, Pack Mule 6), a mercenary 2. Weapons, armor and equipment usually weigh 1 W (heavy weapons and the Laser Marker 2 W), loot and nuke parts 2 W. Whatever no longer fits stays behind. Single-use equipment (hand grenade, flashbang, Khan's knife) is used in combat via the combat buttons – hand grenade and flashbang once per expedition each. The combat stimulant works on death automatically, the ancient defibrillator revives a fallen ranger, the ballistic shield reduces every hit by 1. Health only regenerates in the base.
texte.Jederzeit im Kampf: Die Expedition wird: Any time in combat: the expedition is called off, all rangers return to the base unharmed.

texte.Klicke eine Einheit an und dann ihr Ziel: Click a unit and then its destination. Routes: base ↔ preparation → exit (wasteland) → surface (zones 1–5) → back into the Metro. Every station you own – including a captured one – has a base, preparation and exit; station attacks start from the exit of that station. Outside, a squad can switch from any zone directly to any other zone or go back to the wasteland – there it is immediately ready for ambushes and attacks and keeps its loot. Whoever enters the exit from inside the Metro is exhausted for one round. Every unit moves once per round. You equip weapons and armor from your storage on rangers in the base or in preparation. Equipped gear stays on the ranger when returning; only found loot is handed in. To put gear away, select the ranger and use the action under “Put equipment into storage”.

texte.Linksklick wählt aus, Rechtsklick hebt d: Left click selects, right click clears the selection. Hovering over cards, units and buildings shows details. The mouse wheel scrolls the action list, storage and log. Space: end phase · Enter: fight / continue · Esc: menu · F1: guide · M: sound on/off · F11: fullscreen. Clicking several units one after another selects them together – one click on the destination moves all that may go there. Hovering over a unit shows its equipment window with weapon, armor, equipment and loot. In Menu › Options you set the music and effects volume and the Discord status. The game saves automatically after every move; “Save game” also creates your own saves, “Load game” loads or deletes them.

texte.Pilzfarm (+50 Nahrung), Schweinefarm (+1: Mushroom Farm (+50 food), Pig Farm (+100), Ammo Factory (+50 ammo), Gunsmith (+100), Marketplace (+25/+25, trade between players), Customs Post (+25 ammo, one Hansa contract each), Barracks (+1 ranger), Main Hall (+3 rangers, once per player), Tavern, Infirmary (full healing), Mercenary Outpost, DShK (helps defend), Hermetic Gate (protects against mutants). Every station has 6 building slots. Click a built building to upgrade or demolish it. Upgrading (up to level 3) costs the base price times the current level and multiplies income and ranger slots (level 2 double, level 3 triple); defenders like the DShK get +1 attack and +2 health per level. Each Main Station upgrade brings 2 more building slots and 2 more ranger slots (300 ammo, then 600 ammo). Defense, preparation and exit show 5, 7 or 9 places depending on the level; use the arrows to reach more rangers. Demolishing returns 25 % of the building costs – the Main Station stays.

Over the Internet the host must forward the TCP port in the router – or you use a VPN such as ZeroTier or Radmin VPN. texte.Zu Beginn jeder Runde schütten deine Geb: At the start of every round your buildings pay out their income, then you pay the running costs: every station 50 food, every ranger 10 food, every mercenary 25 ammo. If food runs short, you get debts and every round a ranger leaves you. Then three phases follow. All players play every phase at the same time; whoever is done presses “End phase” (space). The next phase starts when everyone is done – the top right shows who is still playing. While someone is fighting or a trade offer awaits an answer, the others pause briefly.

texte.„Erkunden“ zieht so viele Karten aus dem: “Explore” draws as many cards from the zone’s danger deck as your squad has units: monsters, events, anomalies – sometimes invasion cards, the Nest or places like the Forgotten Station. Then you decide: fight, flee, use equipment or play combat cards. Mercenaries return to the wasteland (exit) after an expedition. In “Hard” at least 2 cards are always drawn, in the “Extreme” deck at least 3 – teams are needed there. An awareness roll (d6) decides who strikes first: 1 = the enemies, 2–3 = at the same time, 4–6 = your squad. Going alone gives −1, a squad of 2 or more units +1, of 4 or more +2 (scouts and silenced weapons +1 each). Every fighter attacks a different target, extra ones the weakest. Armor absorbs as many points of damage per fight as its strength. Whoever can do nothing in the expedition (no squad outside, nobody ready at the exit) is done automatically. After a victory every surviving unit draws a loot card. With ready units at the exit you can also ambush other squads (they loot the fallen) or attack stations: Sparta Base, occupied Hansa, other stations (after the grace period of 3 rounds).
